summary: Repaired the census grid-model defect classes through the shared interpreter path in a100c/frontend/gridmodel.py (no per-operator branches). Mechanisms added: (1) interpretation of module-level helper functions (_case/_aligned/_dims/ref, step- and depth-budgeted, degrading to opaque) so grids assigned through helper-computed locals and view extents through _aligned extract; (2) dict literals with ** spreads merge mappings; (3) the RETURNED payload's grid is authoritative over a dead local 'grid' (the quant_transpose/matmul_triton2 dead-local class); (4) holed grid expressions: arithmetic over values the model cannot see keeps the tree shape with identity-carrying Hole leaves instead of collapsing; (5) tie registries that rewrite each axis top-down -- a subtree or hole the interpreter proved equal (same SymVal or structurally equal gexpr) to a scalar kernel argument or a view extent becomes a runtime bundle read, and one equal to a meta/launch_meta constexpr (identity-signed, the lambda form's declared rule) folds to a constant; (6) triton.next_power_of_2 memoized per argument identity (pure call) so a meta occurrence ties an inline occurrence; (7) for-loops over concrete ranges (capped), tracked tuples, concrete lists and dict.items()/.keys()/.values() unroll, with continue/break; symbolic-bound range loops conservatively opaque-ify the names they rebind (arrays keep extents); (8) branch merges keep per-key provenance both arms agree on; decidable isinstance(x, np.ndarray) and BoolOp short-circuit make the corpus dtype-normalization idiom survive; (9) oracle_args and non-kernel/constexpr args are excluded from ties (the tril_rows/N_pre false-friend class); (10) mixed-arity SHAPES without a payload shape echo leave the arity unknown (never guessed -- the fht/cholesky wrong-model class); (11) rng.uniform added to the size-tailed draw set; array .sum() no longer mis-modeled as the extent product; (12) the np.ceil(a/b) realization uses the positive-domain cdiv form (the negation form's negative intermediate was wrong under the lowering's unsigned division -- tanh launched zero programs). Results: of the 56 owned operators, 55 extract with a passing self-check and 1 (gn_finalize) keeps its located genuinely-untraceable refusal (the grid factors n,g are in no bundle quantity; only their product is visible). Full-corpus extraction census: 2649/2734 cases extract (was 2197), 85 refusals remain, all located and named (45 genuinely-untied shape axes, 28 untracked-hole values, 12 case-layer for-loops outside the model). Owned-filtered compile sweep: 257 identities -> 110 artifacts + 147 located refusals at later constructs; grid/for refusals reduced from 257 identity-rows to 3 (gn_finalize, named). The sweep exits 1 on one driver check, 'refusals-located-and-countable': 4 newly-reachable rows at the allocation and tl.arange lanes lack source locations -- a pre-existing diagnostic gap in those stages (the prior recorded full census carries 78 such rows), not a grid-model defect. Execution verification: 31 newly-extracting cases executed and compared against their own references/policies at 1 and 4 worker threads (PASS); 9 refuse at located later stages; 8 execution failures (index_select_cat, mean_dim, dequantize_matmul, gdn_gate_fwd, softmax_multi_block, layer_norm_forward_tiled) were attributed to downstream lanes by a differential that forces compile-time-constant grids of the same values in scratch copies -- all six fail identically with constant grids, so the runtime grid evaluation is not the cause.
